newsitem.title: USA: Medtronic releases beStent in Europe.
newsitem.headline: Medtronic releases beStent in Europe.

text.p: Medtronic said it released commercially its beStent Artist coronary stent systems in Europe and other world markets.
The beStent systems can be used with catheters, guidewires, balloon dilatation catheters and other accessories for treatment of coronary artery disease, said the company.

A stent is a wire-mesh tube placed inside a diseased human blood vessel to keep it from clogging. The beStent is designed for use in blood vessels in the heart following a procedure called angioplasty, in which blood vessels are cleared of clog-causing plaque by a small balloon on a catheter.
